When you share one app, RiriProjector mirrors only that app\'s sound. To know which app you picked it needs Usage access. Without it, sound from all apps is mirrored.

Link the tablet straight to the projector, without the router: steadier sound and lower latency. Keep the tablet in the same room. While mirroring, a Fire TV leaves its router network.
